extracted.name: Nippy Pork Salad
extracted.description: A nice change from chicken salad or ham spread, this easy cooked pork spread is perfect for crackers or sandwiches, or just to mound on lettuce leaves. It's a great way to use leftover pork from a roast.
ingredient_lines: 4 teaspoons fat-free creamy salad dressing (such as Miracle Whip Free®)
2 drops hot pepper sauce (such as Tabasco®), or to taste
instruction_lines: Mix the pork, celery, and green onions in a large bowl.

Combine the mustard, creamy salad dressing, horseradish, hot pepper sauce, and salt in blender. Blend to make a saucy dressing, about 1 minute. Lightly toss the dressing with the pork mixture. Cover and refrigerate until serving.
